AI Weekly Digest
Review Intelligence

Review Intelligence tracks public App Store and Google Play reviews for Arena Club and its top competitors, scraped and processed every Monday. Each review gets a sentiment — positive, negative, or neutral — based on star rating and review text, then tagged with a complaint or praise theme — categories like Value, Customer Service, or App Experience — so patterns are instantly visible. Reviews are never dropped: the archive is backed to May 23, 2026 and grows with every weekly scrape. The dashboard refreshes every Monday, updating ratings, sentiment trends, theme counts, the competitor map, edge report, weekly momentum, and the AI digest.
